author: Kelly Maricle
title: Ames man arrested on sexual exploitation and bestiality charges - NewsBreak
text:
By Kelly Maricle ,
1 days ago AMES, Iowa -- An Ames man was arrested earlier this week on sexual exploitation charges for allegedly possessing images of child pornography and bestiality.
Zachary Vince Zachary Vince, 27, is charged with three counts of sexual exploitation of a minor, five counts of purchase/possess depiction of minor in sex act, and one count of bestiality, according to online court records. He was booked into the Story County Jail Monday with a $150,000 bond set. On Thursday, he was released after a judge agreed to reduce his bond to $72,000 cash-only.
11,000+ photos depicting minors in sex acts found on DSM man’s phone, DMPD says A search warrant filed in the case shows the Iowa State University Police Department began investigating in April after the Iowa Division of Criminal Investigation assigned them a tip received by the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children.
The tip stated that images of "apparent child pornography" were uploaded by a Kik account, later linked to Vince, between October 2024 and November 2025. Vince was a student at Iowa State University and was living on campus at that time, according to court documents.
Search warrants obtained by investigators allowed them to seize Vince's electronic devices for examination. The charging documents state that child sex abuse material was found on the devices.
Investigators also learned from reviewing data from Kik that Vince had been discussing child sex abuse material with other users and talking about trading it. According to a criminal complaint, Vince said that many of the shared files he "filmed myself."
Images of bestiality were found on Vince's laptop, and conversations in Kik discussed his purchasing it. Investigators stated he used Venmo to pay for the videos.
A preliminary hearing for Vince is scheduled for October 5.
